entities.name: Rith's Grove
entities.description: Home of the treefolk Nemata, who hosted the prison of the primeval dragon Rith, in Yavimaya.

entities.name: Nemata
entities.description: Giant magnigoth treefolk who holds Rith's prison.

entities.name: Rith, the Awakener
entities.description: Primeval dragon of Yavimaya, imprisoned in Nemata.

entities.name: Rhammidarigaaz
entities.description: Red primeval dragon who entered the grove.

entities.name: Kavu
entities.description: Native creatures who sang to wake Nemata.

events.summary: In the Fall of the Primevals Rith is captured by the green Numena and put inside Nemata.
events.quote: Rith , was captured by the green Numena , and put inside the Magnigoth Treefolk Nemata

events.summary: Darigaaz and the Dragon Nations enter the grove; Darigaaz fights and kills Rokun.
Rokun's blood loosens Nemata's grip and Rith frees herself.
events.quote: she was able to free herself from her imprisonment

events.summary: The kavu's song wakes Nemata, who with other treefolk recaptures Rith in Urborg and returns.
events.quote: Nemata and hundreds of other treefolk left the forest to recapture Rith, which they eventually did in Urborg

events.summary: During the second Phyrexian invasion Rith escapes again and Nemata sets out to recapture her.
events.quote: Rith suddenly escaped her grove again

relations.quote: put inside the Magnigoth Treefolk Nemata
